heading_en: Transitional Measures for Non-Controlling Interests, etc.
summary_ja: 連結子法人等の非支配株主持分等のうち調整後の持分に算入されなかった部分について、適用日から5年間、表の率を乗じた額を、対応する資本区分の基礎項目に算入できる。
summary_en: For five years from the Application Date, allows a declining percentage (100% to 20%) of non-controlling interests not otherwise included to be counted in CET1, Additional Tier 1 or Tier 2 basic items according to the type of instrument of the consolidated subsidiary.
paragraphs: With respect to the amount of the portion of the amount of basic items relating to total capital equivalent to non-controlling interests, etc. of a Consolidated Subsidiary Legal Entity, etc. (meaning the amount of basic items relating to total capital equivalent to non-controlling interests, etc. of a Consolidated Subsidiary Legal Entity, etc. prescribed in Article 8, paragraph (1), item (iii) of the Public Notice) that corresponds to the amount not included, under Article 8, paragraphs (1) through (3) of the Public Notice, in the amount of adjusted non-controlling interests relating to Common Equity Tier 1 Capital listed in Article 5, paragraph (1), item (iv) of the Public Notice, the amount of adjusted non-controlling interests, etc. relating to Additional Tier 1 Capital listed in Article 6, paragraph (1), item (v) of the Public Notice, and the amount of adjusted non-controlling interests, etc. relating to Tier 2 Capital listed in Article 7, paragraph (1), item (v) of the Public Notice, until the date five years have elapsed from the Application Date, of the amount obtained by multiplying that amount by the rate set out in the right-hand column of the following table, according to the period category set out in the left-hand column of that table, the amount of the portion corresponding to the common shares (meaning the common shares prescribed in Article 5, paragraph (3) of the Public Notice) of the Consolidated Subsidiary Legal Entity, etc. (meaning the Consolidated Subsidiary Legal Entity, etc. prescribed in Article 1, item (x) of the Public Notice; the same applies hereinafter in this Article) may be included in the amount of basic items relating to Common Equity Tier 1 Capital in the formula of Article 2, item (i) of the Public Notice, the amount of the portion corresponding to the Additional Tier 1 Capital instruments (meaning the Additional Tier 1 Capital instruments prescribed in Article 6, paragraph (4) of the Public Notice) of the Consolidated Subsidiary Legal Entity, etc. may be included in the amount of basic items relating to Additional Tier 1 Capital in the formula of Article 2, item (ii) of the Public Notice, and the amount of the portion corresponding to the Tier 2 Capital instruments (meaning the Tier 2 Capital instruments prescribed in Article 7, paragraph (5) of the Public Notice) of the Consolidated Subsidiary Legal Entity, etc. may be included in the amount of basic items relating to Tier 2 Capital in the formula of Article 2, item (iii) of the Public Notice. {{T:p435t0}}
